requirements.design_implication: Separate screening, SBT, airway readiness and prevention planning.
requirements.interface_requirement: Trial and extubation panels with shared sedation links
requirements.limits: Initial trial technique and high-risk prevention require source-specific/local reconciliation.

requirements.design_implication: Assess indication before recording cuff leak.
requirements.interface_requirement: High-risk airway section; not universal checklist requirement
requirements.limits: No automated steroid order or universal testing rule.

requirements.design_implication: Keep acidotic COPD as a distinct clinical indication.
requirements.interface_requirement: Hypercapnic/COPD assessment with gas trajectory and escalation context
requirements.limits: No patient treatment selection until exact scope, thresholds and local activation are approved.

requirements.design_implication: Cardiogenic oedema differs from COPD; shock applicability cannot be assumed.
requirements.interface_requirement: Link circulation and explicit assessment of cause
requirements.limits: No inference of cardiogenic oedema from gas or fluid balance.

requirements.design_implication: Review surgical complications and airway protection before pathway applicability.
requirements.interface_requirement: Separate postoperative-failure context with procedure links
requirements.limits: Not a generic order; no automatic surgical-complication diagnosis.

requirements.design_implication: Prevention after planned extubation differs from treatment after deterioration.
requirements.interface_requirement: Separate prevention and deterioration workflow labels
requirements.limits: Do not apply preventive recommendations as rescue policy.

requirements.original_strength: conditional in ERS; comparator-specific in ATS
requirements.design_implication: Preserve comparator and indication rather than merge device rankings.
requirements.interface_requirement: Why panel displays source/year/comparator and unresolved adaptation
requirements.limits: Full-text reconciliation required; no universal HFNC preference.

requirements.design_implication: Document oxygen target, gas monitoring and reassessment/escalation capability in COPD.
requirements.interface_requirement: Patient-specific target and timed support-response sections
requirements.limits: Dated COPD scope; not an all-patient target or current new NIV guideline.

requirements.design_implication: In-development guidance cannot be presented as published recommendations.
requirements.limits: No claim of exhaustive absence; final publication status must be rechecked before activation.

requirements.source_locator: AARC abstract/recommendations; CHEST initial SBT recommendation
requirements.design_implication: Record technique and reconcile the selected protocol.
requirements.interface_requirement: Trial details; RSBI optional; actual oxygen changes visible
requirements.limits: Passing trial is not extubation readiness; no mandatory RSBI gate.

requirements.design_implication: Patient and measurement conditions accompany settings.
requirements.limits: No passive mechanics from invalid effort/hold/leak conditions.

requirements.original_strength: not extracted as one composite grade
requirements.original_certainty: not applicable to the combined field design
requirements.design_implication: Preserve specimen, collection, support and measured/source-calculated distinctions.
requirements.interface_requirement: Specimen-first gas display and sample support relation
requirements.limits: Venous/capillary/circuit oxygen cannot be systemic arterial oxygen.

requirements.original_strength: separate management recommendation and definition consensus
requirements.design_implication: Keep definition eligibility separate from treatment review.
requirements.limits: No diagnosis from P/F alone; no combined Berlin/Global criteria.
No numerical correction based on race or assumption of accuracy from one reading.
